policy: Every requirement below is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the ICP page named in source_roles. Nothing is paraphrased into an excerpt and nothing is inferred. Where the authority states a figure, the figure is quoted rather than restated.
structure_note: The Golden Residency is not one eligibility test but six category-specific ones — investors, humanitarian pioneers, entrepreneurs, outstanding students, exceptional talent, and real-estate investors — each with its own duration and its own documents. Requirements are therefore scoped to a category in their label rather than presented as a single checklist an applicant must satisfy in full. Presenting them as one list would tell an entrepreneur they need AED 2 million in an investment fund, which the page does not say.
freshness_note: The page publishes a dateline of 2026-08-20 and its body references 2026. That is the freshness signal Austria's pages lack entirely, and it is why this route was extracted first.
not_extracted: Visit and tourist visas. The ICP services index enumerates only the Blue, Golden and Green Residency routes; short-stay entry for the UAE is administered partly by the emirate-level GDRFA authorities, which have not been probed. The catalogue here is what this authority's own index publishes, not the whole of UAE entry policy.
The Blue and Green Residency routes, which are enumerable from the same index and not yet extracted.
Fees. The page names no fee amounts, so none is recorded.

requirements.label: No sponsor is required
requirements.description: Unlike most UAE residence routes, the Golden Residency is granted without a sponsoring employer or individual, and runs for five or ten years with automatic renewal depending on the category.
requirements.source_excerpt: the golden residency is one of the flagship initiatives of the federal authority for identity, citizenship, customs and port security (icp). it enables eligible individuals to obtain long-term residency in the united arab emirates for a period of five or ten years, with automatic renewal, without the need for a sponsor.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The Golden Residency is one of the flagship initiatives of the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP). It enables eligible individuals to obtain long-term residency in the United Arab Emirates for a period of five or ten years, with automatic renewal, without the need for a sponsor.

requirements.label: Investors: minimum capital of AED 2 million
requirements.description: Applies to the public-investment category, which the authority grants for ten years.
requirements.source_excerpt: a minimum capital investment of aed 2 million.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A minimum capital investment of AED 2 million.

requirements.label: Investors: or an establishment paying AED 250,000 in annual taxes
requirements.description: An alternative to the capital threshold for the same category — the page states it as an either/or, not an additional requirement.
requirements.source_excerpt: ownership of real estate or a stake in an establishment that pays annual taxes of no less than aed 250,000.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Ownership of real estate or a stake in an establishment that pays annual taxes of no less than AED 250,000.

requirements.label: Investors: letter from an accredited investment fund
requirements.description: Documentary proof of the deposit behind the capital threshold above.
requirements.source_excerpt: a letter from an accredited investment fund confirming the existence of a deposit of no less than aed 2 million.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A letter from an accredited investment fund confirming the existence of a deposit of no less than AED 2 million.

requirements.label: Real-estate investors: land registration department letter
requirements.description: The authority requires the property to be unencumbered — it says 'without loans'.
requirements.source_excerpt: a letter from the land registration department confirming ownership of one or more properties valued at ≥ aed 2 million (without loans).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A letter from the Land Registration Department confirming ownership of one or more properties valued at ≥ AED 2 million (without loans).

requirements.label: Real-estate investors: proof of residence in the UAE
requirements.description: Either property ownership or a tenancy contract satisfies this.
requirements.source_excerpt: proof of residence in the uae (property ownership or tenancy contract).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Proof of residence in the UAE (property ownership or tenancy contract).

requirements.label: Entrepreneurs: an innovative or technology-based project
requirements.description: The authority scopes this category by the nature of the project rather than by a capital figure.

requirements.label: Entrepreneurs: documents verifying the project's value
requirements.description: The page does not state a threshold figure for entrepreneurs, only that the value must be evidenced.
requirements.source_excerpt: documents verifying the value of the project.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Documents verifying the value of the project.

requirements.label: Entrepreneurs: letter from a business incubator or the emirate's authority
requirements.description: Either an accredited incubator or the relevant authority in the emirate may issue it.
requirements.source_excerpt: a letter from a business incubator or the relevant authority in the emirate.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A letter from a business incubator or the relevant authority in the emirate.

requirements.label: Outstanding students: excellence certificates
requirements.description: The authority grants five years for outstanding high-school students and ten for university students.

requirements.label: Outstanding students: recommendation letters
requirements.description: Issued by the school or university the applicant attends.
requirements.source_excerpt: recommendation letters from the school or university.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Recommendation letters from the school or university.

requirements.label: Humanitarian pioneers: certificates of appreciation
requirements.description: Recognition of the outstanding efforts on which this category is granted.
requirements.source_excerpt: certificates of appreciation or documentation of outstanding efforts.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Certificates of appreciation or documentation of outstanding efforts.

requirements.label: Humanitarian pioneers: five years' involvement or 500 volunteer hours
requirements.description: The authority states these as alternatives, and the volunteer-hours figure is a minimum.
requirements.source_excerpt: proof of involvement in humanitarian organisations for ≥ 5 years or completion of at least 500 volunteer hours.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Proof of involvement in humanitarian organisations for ≥ 5 years or completion of at least 500 volunteer hours.

requirements.label: Passport copy and health insurance
requirements.description: Listed by the authority among the required documents for the humanitarian category.
